---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement for Circadian Display
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Summary

A clear, one-sentence description of the feature you are proposing.

---

## Problem Being Solved

What problem does this feature solve? Who experiences this problem and in what situation?

Example: "As a user who reads before bed, I often need to quickly disable the overlay to check a photo without navigating through the app."

---

## Proposed Solution

Describe the feature or change you would like to see. Be as specific as you can.

---

## Alternatives Considered

Have you considered any alternative solutions or workarounds? Why do you prefer your proposed solution over them?

---

## Scope Check

Before submitting, please confirm this feature is not in the explicit Non-Goals list in [PRODUCT_REQUIREMENTS.md](../../PRODUCT_REQUIREMENTS.md).

- [ ] I have checked the Non-Goals list and this feature is not listed there.

---

## Additional Context

Any mockups, screenshots of similar apps, or other context that would help explain the feature.

---

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues and this is not a duplicate.
- [ ] I have described the problem this feature solves, not just the solution.
- [ ] This feature aligns with the project's privacy-first, offline-first philosophy.
